title: Map of Topra and Delhi Ashoka Pillar route
subject: Geography
caption: Map of the Ashoka Pillar relocation from Topra to Delhi.
altText: A textbook‑style map on a white background showing the route of the Ashoka Pillar moving from Topra in the Pong Valley (southwest of Delhi) to the Feroz Shah Kotla site in Delhi. The map displays regional boundaries, the Yamuna River, major roads, and a bold arrow indicating the direction of travel, with clearly labelled locations, a scale bar, and a compass rose.
